scope: All source-derived members of 3 overlapping families; excludes rituals and the deferred Phase 9 review list. Every member was recompiled under a detached name/ID. Route assessment is not live execution.

families.title: Conditions ended by the creature’s own Interact action or Escape
families.definition: Descriptions where the affected creature ends a condition or effect with an Interact action or an Escape.

families.title: Creature-state immunity
families.definition: Descriptions making creatures without blood, organs, breath or similar states immune or unaffected.

families.title: Save preambles with while, entering or counteract
families.definition: Save spells whose rules before the degree table mention while, entering an area, or counteracting.
